args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an **18% error rate**.
- The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, and v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, so neither qualified).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — the rollback was confirmed as rolled out (us-east, us-west, and eu-west all now on v2.3.0).
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for `checkout-api` describing the failure of v2.3.1 across all regions, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a request to investigate root cause — noting that both v2.3.1-rc (staging) and v2.3.1 (production) were unhealthy, which suggests the issue exists in both builds. The on-call engineer has been paged.

One note: the incident creation call initially returned a 502 error, but I verified via the incident list that the incident was in fact created successfully (INC-0001, status: open), so no duplicate was filed.
